name: 薄荷织网
direction: A humane community-compute product with a cool mint and deep forest visual identity. Airy spacing, 24–28 logical px softly rounded cards and pill controls, gentle layered surfaces, humanist Chinese sans serif, generous touch targets. Signature: a very subtle thin connecting thread relating provider avatars and resource cards, suggesting voluntary peer sharing. Mint is structural, not botanical illustration. White and green, not generic beige; no stock photos, no cartoon leaves, no heavy blur.
